name: Vietnamese Chicken Wings with Rice, Pickled Veggies & Peanuts (Prep-Ahead)

ingredients.name: chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses 4 medium, 4 small, and 4 mini food storage containers.
Preheat oven to 500°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional), then coat with a thin layer of oil.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet, spread out in an even layer, and drizzle with additional oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
907 g chicken wings, split with tips removed
4 tsp cornstarch
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping once, until wings are cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the wings are baking, place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl, then whisk to combine the pickling liquid. Divide between the mini containers, cover, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup rice vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 English cucumber
1 bunch radish
½ small bunch cilantro
1 lime

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the carrot.
Trim and halve radishes, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the veggies. Divide between the small containers and set aside. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Roughly chop peanuts. Set both aside.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in the reserved bowl.

Zest and juice lime into the bowl with the garlic. Add fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar, then whisk to combine the sauce. When the wings are done, add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp fish sauce
4 tsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Divide rice, wings, and any sauce left in the bowl between medium containers, then set aside to cool completely, about 30 minutes. Once cool, sprinkle wings with cilantro and peanuts. Cover containers and refrigerate until ready to eat. About 10 minutes before eating, add the pickling liquid to the small container with the veggies and stir to combine. Heat rice and wings in an oven or microwave and enjoy with quick pickled veggies!
